title: Debias your Large Multi-Modal Model at Test-Time via Non-Contrastive Visual Attribute Steering

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the frequency of explicit mentions of perceived race in open-ended image descriptions using annotated bigram frequencies and LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o), and analyzing group-specific sentiment disparities across race groups using the VADER sentiment analysis tool.

Evaluating the propensity of LMMs to generate age-related text in response to images by counting age-related bigrams, using GPT-4o to identify mentions, and calculating sentiment scores across different age groups to check for disparities.
Counting references to gender in generated image captions using bigram matching and LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o), alongside evaluating sentiment parity across gender groups using VADER.

Detecting references to physical appearance and body type in open-ended visual question answering and descriptions via bigram counts and an LLM judge, and measuring sentiment differences across various body type groups.
